title: Robot Learning with Visual Predicted Force
abstract: arXiv:2610.04741v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Force-aware manipulation typically relies on specialized force or tactile sensors. We show that force-aware manipulation can instead be achieved through visual force prediction from the deformation of a compliant Fin Ray gripper. Our approach trains two models. First, we train a visual force estimator on calibration data and use it to annotate task demonstrations with force estimates. Second, we train an action--force proposal policy on these force-augmented demonstrations to jointly generate candidate robot actions and their associated forces. At test time, we sample candidate actions and the forces they are expected to produce, then execute the action whose predicted force is closest to a target from the demonstrations. We evaluate our approach on berry picking, empty-can grasping, in-hand reorientation, and plug insertion. Our results show that visual force prediction can guide inference-time action selection for contact-ric

translated_title: 基于视觉预测力的机器人学习
translated_abstract: 力感知操作通常依赖于专用的力传感器或触觉传感器。我们证明了力感知操作可以通过视觉力预测来实现，即从柔性Fin Ray夹爪的形变中预测受力。我们的方法训练了两个模型：首先，在校准数据上训练一个视觉力估计器，并用它为任务演示数据标注力估计值；其次，在这些带有力标注的演示数据上训练一个动作-力提议策略，联合生成候选机器人动作及其对应的力。在测试阶段，我们采样候选动作及其预期产生的力，然后执行预测力与演示中目标力最接近的动作。我们在采浆果、空罐抓取、手中重定向和插头插入任务上评估了该方法。结果表明，视觉力预测可以引导接触丰富任务在推理阶段的动作选择。
tldr: 该论文提出利用柔性Fin Ray夹爪形变的视觉力预测来替代专用力/触觉传感器，通过训练视觉力估计器与动作-力提议策略，在推理时依据预测力与目标力的匹配来选择最优动作，从而无需实体力传感器即可实现力感知操作。
